name: Wiley the Black
summary: At the Lakeshire Inn, Wiley the Black keeps out of sight. He owes his life to Gryan Stoutmantle and shares what he knows of the Defias Brotherhood.

sections.title: A Scoundrel's Debt
sections.body: Wiley the Black keeps to the Lakeshire Inn, away from Westfall's turmoil and Redridge's gnoll-infested borders. He owes his life to Gryan Stoutmantle, commander of the People's Militia, who once saved him. Stoutmantle grumbles that he should have let Wiley rot. When the militia needs insight into the Defias conspiracy, it turns to Wiley. He reluctantly shares covert intelligence to repay his debt.

faq.q: Where can I find Wiley the Black?
faq.answer: Wiley the Black is inside the Lakeshire Inn in the town of Lakeshire, in the Redridge Mountains.

faq.q: Why is Wiley helping Gryan Stoutmantle?
faq.answer: Gryan Stoutmantle once saved Wiley's life. Wiley repays that debt by sharing information about the Defias Brotherhood, though he is reluctant to stick his neck out.

faq.q: How does Wiley know about the Defias Brotherhood?
faq.answer: Wiley knows the underworld and Defias operations well. He shares what he knows to repay Gryan Stoutmantle, but whether he once belonged to the Brotherhood is unconfirmed.

faq.q: What role does he play in the Defias investigation?
faq.answer: When the People's Militia captures clues to a larger conspiracy, Stoutmantle sends adventurers to Lakeshire with a message for Wiley. Wiley examines the situation and writes a note directing the militia toward the rebellion's leaders.

angles.text: As a rogue, Wiley shows how tradecraft and intelligence can keep someone alive. He knows when to trade information and whom to repay.
With Stormwind's army absent, the Alliance relies on unofficial contacts like Wiley to piece together the rebellion in Westfall.
